scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the live M6 xAPI launch-trace export already opened from the LMS sandbox for the adaptive-release practice artifact.
Emerging Need: The export begins writing trace segments, then the same job enters an integrity hold with learner controls disabled, so the active evidence attempt cannot continue unaided.
Decision Context: Stored milestone, design-record, and protocol notes identify the qualifying artifact, continuity-only route, safe identifiers, queue seal, and no-duplicate-export boundary; live records supply job, VM, and verified desk details.
Consequence: Timely desk continuity could preserve the same export job for same-day evidence, while queue seal leaves later rebuilds stamped outside the intended batch.
